name: Basalt Server
author: oscargarciasoriano@outlook.com
description: Basalt Server is a Minecraft server rewritten from scratch in C++23, shipped as a native binary with no external JVM. This egg downloads the prebuilt binary from GitHub Releases.

installation.script:
#!/bin/ash
set -eu

apk add --no-cache curl jq coreutils
mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

case "$(uname -m)" in
    x86_64|amd64) ARCH="x64" ;;
    aarch64|arm64) ARCH="arm64" ;;
    *) echo "Unsupported architecture: $(uname -m)"; exit 1 ;;
esac

REPO="${GITHUB_PACKAGE:-BasaltProject/Server}"
TAG="${VERSION:-latest}"
SUMS_URL=""

if [ -n "${DOWNLOAD_URL:-}" ]; then
    URL="$DOWNLOAD_URL"
else
    # Asset names carry the build version, so they have to be looked up.
    if [ "$TAG" = "latest" ]; then
        API="https://api.github.com/repos/${REPO}/releases/latest"
    else
        API="https://api.github.com/repos/${REPO}/releases/tags/${TAG}"
    fi
    RELEASE=$(curl -fsSL -H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" "$API")
    URL=$(echo "$RELEASE" | jq -r --arg arch "$ARCH" '[.assets[] | select(.name | test("^BasaltServer-.*-Linux-" + $arch + "$"))][0].browser_download_url // empty')
    SUMS_URL=$(echo "$RELEASE" | jq -r '[.assets[] | select(.name == "SHA256SUMS")][0].browser_download_url // empty')
    TAG=$(echo "$RELEASE" | jq -r '.tag_name')
    if [ -z "$URL" ]; then
        echo "No Linux ${ARCH} binary found in release ${TAG} of ${REPO}"
        exit 1
    fi
fi

echo "Downloading Basalt Server from: $URL"
curl -fsSL "$URL" -o basalt.new

if [ -n "$SUMS_URL" ]; then
    EXPECTED=$(curl -fsSL "$SUMS_URL" | awk -v name="$(basename "$URL")" '$2 == name { print $1 }')
    if [ -z "$EXPECTED" ]; then
        echo "$(basename "$URL") is not listed in SHA256SUMS"
        rm -f basalt.new
        exit 1
    fi
    echo "$EXPECTED  basalt.new" | sha256sum -c -
fi

mv basalt.new basalt
chmod +x basalt

# A full template keeps the documented options of every table in one place. If it
# cannot be fetched, start.sh seeds a minimal file and Basalt completes it.
if [ -z "${DOWNLOAD_URL:-}" ] && [ ! -f config/server.toml ]; then
    mkdir -p config
    curl -fsSL "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/${REPO}/${TAG}/server-runtime/resources/config-defaults/server.toml" \
        -o config/server.toml || rm -f config/server.toml
fi

cat > start.sh <<'START'
#!/bin/bash
# Written by the egg on install and replaced on reinstall. Each start pins the
# ports to the panel allocation, so port edits in config/server.toml do not last.
CONFIG=config/server.toml
BEDROCK=$([ "${BEDROCK_ENABLED:-0}" = "1" ] && echo true || echo false)

if [ ! -f "$CONFIG" ]; then
    # Basalt appends every missing option to this file on its first start.
    mkdir -p config
    printf '[network.java]\nport = %s\n\n[network.bedrock]\nenabled = %s\nport = %s\n' \
        "$SERVER_PORT" "$BEDROCK" "$SERVER_PORT" > "$CONFIG"
else
    sed -i \
        -e "/^\[network\.java\]/,/^\[/ s/^port *=.*/port = ${SERVER_PORT}/" \
        -e "/^\[network\.bedrock\]/,/^\[/ s/^port *=.*/port = ${SERVER_PORT}/" \
        -e "/^\[network\.bedrock\]/,/^\[/ s/^enabled *=.*/enabled = ${BEDROCK}/" \
        "$CONFIG"
fi

if [ "${EULA:-0}" = "1" ]; then
    exec ./basalt --accept-eula
fi
exec ./basalt
START
chmod +x start.sh

echo "Basalt Server installed."

variables.name: Accept Minecraft EULA
variables.description: Set to 1 to accept the Minecraft EULA (https://www.minecraft.net/en-us/eula). The server will not start until it is accepted.

variables.name: Bedrock Support
variables.description: Set to 1 to accept Bedrock clients on the primary allocation port (UDP), 0 to disable them. With Bedrock on, do not enable [network.query] on that same port.

variables.name: Basalt Version
variables.description:
Release tag to install: latest (newest stable release), nightly (development builds) or a specific tag such as v26.3.1.
Scope: installation

variables.name: GitHub Repository
variables.description:
GitHub repository in owner/repo format to download releases from. Useful if you are using a fork.
Scope: installation

variables.name: Direct Download URL
variables.description:
Direct URL to a Linux Basalt binary. Overrides the version and repository, and skips the checksum check.
